mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT x.*, ROWNUM AS rn FROM ( SELECT rv.rv_content , rv.rv_id , rv.mb_id , rv.rv_rating , rv.rv_show , dr.dr_product , dr.dr_id , dr.dr_sungsang , rv.rv_reg_date FROM REVIEW_TB rv JOIN DRUG_TB dr ON rv.dr_id = dr.dr_id WHERE rv.mb_id = #{mbId} AND rv.rv_show = 'Y' ORDER BY rv.rv_reg_date DESC ) x WHERE ROWNUM <= #{end} ) WHERE rn >= #{start}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM REVIEW_TB WHERE rv_show = 'Y' AND mb_id = #{mb_id}
SELECT r.rv_rating , r.rv_id , r.rv_content , r.rv_show , d.dr_id , d.dr_product , d.dr_sungsang FROM REVIEW_TB r JOIN DRUG_TB d ON d.dr_id = r.dr_id WHERE rv_id = #{rv_id}
